intended_claim: Frozen C-refined masked embedding yields lower masked-positive expression MAE than original masked scGPT under the matched fresh linear probe.
confidence_scope: High for fixed-run numerical findings and narrowed descriptive conclusion; no universal rejection of SAE or C methods.
what_results_support: Under the locked protocol, original masked scGPT has lower token MAE and normalized MSE than C in all42 fold/seed pairs and all14 dataset-specific held-out contexts.
Both representations predict masked-positive expression better than the TRAIN gene-mean baseline in MAE.
Kang gene-macro MAE is slightly lower for C on dataset averages, but pair/group directions are mixed; PBMC gene-macro MAE worsens.
what_results_dont_support: C superiority on the prespecified primary expression endpoint.
Every metric worsening: Kang gene-macro MAE has a small opposite-direction mean change.
An information-theoretic loss of biological signal, SAE uselessness, causal mechanisms, general imputation performance, or conclusions about optimal/converged linear probes.
missing_evidence: Independent new biological units/study and prespecified external confirmation.
Evidence that this finite optimizer/stopping grid reaches each representation’s best linear readout; not established by matching1000-step budgets.
Attribution to SAE architecture independent of upstream task supervision; not tested.
suggested_claim_revision: 在固定25%阳性token遮蔽、冻结既有C及原始scGPT表征、相同新线性头训练与VALID选择协议下，C未改善主终点：ctrl、stim、PBMC的TEST token MAE分别增加2.66%、2.32%、6.47%，42/42配对方向一致。Kang逐基因平均MAE有约0.00073的微小、方向混合改善，不能替代主终点。
next_experiments_needed: None to report and close this fixed run honestly. No automatic retraining, tuning, new architecture, or follow-up experiment is authorized by this review.
limitations: Historical exploratory cohorts; no independent new-study confirmation or verified exclusion of scGPT pretraining overlap.

ctrl/stim share six donors, folds overlap in TRAIN, and PBMC has two batch directions. Forty-two pairs and fourteen dataset-specific contexts are not forty-two or fourteen independent biological replicates.
One fixed25pct mask on originally selected positive tokens. Expression presence/token selection is conditioned on; zero-expression and full-transcriptome imputation are outside scope.
C already received TRAIN-expression supervision; new heads have a matched recipe but total upstream supervision/compute is unequal. No SAE-specific necessity or biological causality is identified.

All84 heads select the first nonzero monitored checkpoint, step100, from the fixed0/100/250/500/750/1000 grid. Fixed Adam and this stopping grid do not establish optimal linear-readout capacity or convergence.
Current C checkpoints are fixed parent step1000. Negative results concern these representations and this probe protocol, not all possible C/SAE training methods.

Source scGPT extraction and raw-RNA provenance are inherited from the hash-bound parent audit; this review does not rerun full scGPT extraction. Production verification replays all saved TEST/selected VALID predictions, while manual C forwards and reviewer head checks are bounded; earlier unselected checkpoints were not retrained.

evidence_precheck.interpretation: Mechanical value existence only; semantic review remains same-family/provisional.
